acceptance: Unit tests for candidate selection: the newest qualifying trunk run wins; a non-ancestor, a guarded-path change, a changed trunk-uat.yml, a run from a non-develop ref, a lock change beyond the version line, a non-equivalent wheel, or an expired artifact each disqualify a candidate with a named reason in the job summary
verify-gate accepts evidence where a cell's infrastructure-signature attempt 1 failed and attempt 2 passed, and rejects evidence where attempt 2 failed
Workflow tests: the stages skip only when reuse=true; publish and github-release run on explicit results; the fallback path is the unchanged parallel stages
Live (on the combined tree after rv2r-05 is prepared): a probe-mode run or real rc dispatch shows 'reused trunk UAT run <id> for <sha>' and reaches publish within 30 minutes of admit
Live negative: with a guarded-path change after the trunk evidence, the run falls back to full UAT (probe mode is acceptable evidence)
release-artifacts.md describes the candidate rules and fallback exactly as implemented
context:
Member of batch release-v2-remediation. Prior art: #3947 (reuse), #3956 (explicit publish conditions), #3946 (parallel stages). b7 disposition (owner, 2026-11-05): the wheel-digest binding for envelope-only fixes is superseded by continuous trunk UAT; an envelope fix lands on develop, trunk UAT is dispatched on that commit, and the next tag reuses it. GUARDRAILS: equivalence checks fail closed (any error -> full UAT); never accept evidence whose digest re-check fails; admit and the install matrix always run. DECISION GATE: any relaxation of an equivalence condition beyond the list above needs the owner.

2026-11-05 owner decision (from oracle finding D2 on the legacy-retirement PR): the release evidence check must also require the newest release-canary run (credential-free slow/resource-heavy suite) on an ancestor of the tag commit, no older than 48 h, to be green. This restores the legacy release_readiness_check.py gate in the new model; the canary has run daily for months, which satisfies G12 calibration. Add acceptance in implementation: missing, red, stale (>48 h) or non-ancestor canary refuses the release with a named reason (tests), and the fallback full UAT does not bypass it. Depends in practice on release-canary-green-after-0-5-0 (canary red since 2026-10-31); do not make it blocking while the canary is red without telling the owner.

2026-11-06 BUG from the v0.5.0 run 42133357291: the `uat-reuse` job's decide step failed with `error: unexpected argument '--no-install-project' found` (the runner's `uv run` rejects that flag), so reuse never evaluated and the release fell back to full UAT (fail-closed, as designed, but costing about 3 h). Fix in this item: invoke the script in a form the runner's uv accepts (for example `uv run --locked --no-dev --no-project --with pyyaml` or a pinned requirements install), and prove it live through probe mode (rv2r-05) before relying on reuse. Also: a failed uat-reuse job marks the release run red even when publish succeeds; decide whether a reuse-job error should be reported as 'reuse=false with reason' instead of a job failure.

2026-11-06 leader: removed rv2r-04 (already landed on the integration branch) from needs. Ordinary needs are done-only, and batch members reach done only at batch finish, so a same-batch ordinary need would deadlock the batch; the ordering is guaranteed by the integration branch instead.
description: Owner decision 2026-11-05: a release checks evidence. Generalize the #3947 reuse (scripts/release_reuse_uat_evidence.py, uat-reuse job), which today reuses only a same-version rc's run for a final tag. The new primary source is the newest green trunk UAT run for any tag, rc or final. A candidate must be a `.github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml` run with event schedule or workflow_dispatch and head_branch develop. It qualifies when: its source commit is an ancestor of the tag commit; the guarded UAT inputs are byte-identical (tests/uat, tests/utilities, tests/__init__.py, docker, Makefile, scripts/uat-bring-up, release-uat-env action, .github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml, workflow-level env and the UAT stage job definitions apart from needs/if); uv.lock differs only in the benchbox version line; the wheel and sdist are member-equivalent apart from version lines (candidate version read from its dist file names, not from a tag); and uat-gate-check re-verifies the downloaded evidence against that run's digest. Evidence containing rv2r-04 retries is accepted when a cell's infrastructure-signature attempt 1 failed and attempt 2 passed. Keep the rc-run source as a second candidate. If no candidate qualifies, run the full parallel UAT stages unchanged. publish keeps explicit result checks (#3956). Rollback: revert this member's commits; the rc-run reuse and full-UAT paths remain.
